data.description:

Air China reported solid operational momentum in August 2026, with the group posting year-on-year increases in both passenger capacity and traffic across its network. Available seat kilometers rose 6.3% while revenue passenger kilometers climbed 11.3%, driving the overall passenger load factor up 4 percentage points to 87.7%, a sign of improving demand and better utilization of its fleet.

Domestic and international routes were the main growth drivers, with double-digit gains in passenger traffic and notable improvements in load factors, while regional routes lagged with declines in capacity and traffic. Cargo operations also strengthened, as capacity rose 8.1% and cargo and mail traffic increased 9.2%, pushing the cargo load factor slightly higher; combined with the addition of three narrow-body aircraft, these trends suggest continued recovery in air travel and incremental support for Air China’s revenue base and competitive positioning in the aviation market.
